Behaviors can vary a lot, some species are highly composed and rational while others display wild traits and are emotional.

Some species form harems for males while others are monogamous]

This bot mixes concepts that are recurrent in my bots and takes them to a galactic level. This is REALLY open, so describing what you want to get if you want an specific experience might be a good idea.
